description: Header file defining the ACodec class for media codec operations in Android, including setup, configuration, buffer management, and format handling.

classes.name: ACodec
classes.description: Main class for media codec handling, including setup, configuration, buffer management, and format processing.

methods.name: initiateSetup
methods.description: Starts the setup process with a given message.

methods.name: getBufferChannel
methods.description: Returns the buffer channel associated with the codec.

methods.name: initiateAllocateComponent
methods.description: Begins allocation of the codec component.

methods.name: initiateConfigureComponent
methods.description: Begins configuration of the codec component.

methods.name: setSurface
methods.description: Sets the output surface for the codec.

methods.name: signalFlush
methods.description: Signals the codec to flush buffers.

methods.name: signalResume
methods.description: Signals the codec to resume operation.

methods.name: signalEndOfInputStream
methods.description: Signals end of input stream to the codec.

methods.name: signalRequestIDRFrame
methods.description: Requests an IDR frame from the encoder.

methods.name: onMessageReceived
methods.description: Handles incoming messages, implementing message processing.

methods.name: getAVCLevelFor
methods.description: Calculates AVC level based on video parameters.

methods.name: getOMXChannelMapping
methods.description: Retrieves OMX channel mapping for a given number of channels.

methods.name: allocateBuffersOnPort
methods.description: Allocates buffers for a specified port.

methods.name: freeBuffersOnPort
methods.description: Frees buffers on a specified port.

methods.name: setComponentRole
methods.description: Sets the role (encoder/decoder) for the component.

methods.name: configureCodec
methods.description: Configures the codec with specified parameters.

methods.name: setVideoPortFormatType
methods.description: Sets format type for a video port.

methods.name: setVideoFormatOnPort
methods.description: Sets video format on a specific port.

methods.name: setPortBufferNum
methods.description: Sets number of buffers for a port.

methods.name: initDescribeColorAspectsIndex
methods.description: Initializes index for color aspects description.

methods.name: setCodecColorAspects
methods.description: Sets color aspects for the codec.

methods.name: getCodecColorAspects
methods.description: Retrieves color aspects from the codec.

methods.name: getDataSpace
methods.description: Gets data space guidance from codec and platform.

methods.name: setColorAspectsForVideoDecoder
methods.description: Sets color aspects for video decoder.

methods.name: getColorAspectsAndDataSpaceForVideoDecoder
methods.description: Retrieves color aspects and data space info for video decoder.

methods.name: setColorAspectsForVideoEncoder
methods.description: Sets color aspects for video encoder.

methods.name: setInitialColorAspectsForVideoEncoderSurfaceAndGetDataSpace
methods.description: Sets initial color aspects for surface mode and retrieves data space.

methods.name: getInputColorAspectsForVideoEncoder
methods.description: Gets input color aspects for video encoder.

methods.name: onDataSpaceChanged
methods.description: Handles change in data space and aspects.

methods.name: initDescribeHDRStaticInfoIndex
methods.description: Initializes index for HDR static info description.

methods.name: setHDRStaticInfoForVideoCodec
methods.description: Sets HDR static info for video codec.

methods.name: getHDRStaticInfoForVideoCodec
methods.description: Gets HDR static info for video codec.

methods.name: verifySupportForProfileAndLevel
methods.description: Verifies support for profile and level.

methods.name: allYourBuffersAreBelongToUs
methods.description: Checks if all buffers are owned by the codec or native window.

methods.name: waitUntilAllPossibleNativeWindowBuffersAreReturnedToUs
methods.description: Waits for native window buffers to be returned.

methods.name: countBuffersOwnedByComponent
methods.description: Counts buffers owned by the component.

methods.name: countBuffersOwnedByNativeWindow
methods.description: Counts buffers owned by native window.

methods.name: deferMessage
methods.description: Defers a message for later processing.

methods.name: updateRenderInfoForDequeuedBuffer
methods.description: Updates render info for dequeued buffer.

methods.name: notifyOfRenderedFrames
methods.description: Notifies about rendered frames up to a certain point.

methods.name: onFirstTunnelFrameReady
methods.description: Handles first tunnel frame ready event.

methods.name: onSignalEndOfInputStream
methods.description: Handles end of input stream signal.
